visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a black long-sleeved shirt, sits in the driver's seat of a car. He is talking and looking forward. Outside the window, a sunny urban street with parked motorcycles and shops is visible. (2) A top-down 2D animation illustrates a four-way intersection. A pink car icon attempts a left turn while blue and green car icons move straight. Gray triangular overlays indicate the driver's visual blind spots. (3) The scene returns to the man in the car, who continues speaking while gesturing with his right hand. The car appears to be moving as urban scenery and other vehicles pass by in the background. (4) An animated segment shows a pink car and a green scooter colliding. This is followed by a statistical chart on a dark background showing bar graphs for accident data from years 111 to 113. (5) A split-screen comparison shows two photos of city streets labeled '改善前' (Before) and '改善後' (After), highlighting changes in road markings and medians. (6) The video concludes with a white screen displaying a red triangular logo and the text '新竹市政府 Hsinchu City Government' with a small '廣告' label at the top.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 開車最難的是什麼呀. (2) [Subtitle]: 左轉吧. (3) [Subtitle]: 因為不是每個路口 都有左轉道. (4) [Subtitle]: 難在哪??. (5) [Subtitle]: 哎呦 這麼凶. (6) [Subtitle]: 左轉的時候 你除了要注意 對向的直行車之外. (7) [Subtitle]: 正在轉的時候 其實會有 視線的死角. (8) [Subtitle]: 如果剛好有車子 從死角衝出來 就直接撞在一起. (9) [Subtitle]: 哎呦 太可怕了吧. (10) [Subtitle]: 所以跟你說 如果你在開的時候發現 兩線道以上 車流量又很多 道路缺口沒有交通號誌 不要左轉 直接繞路. (11) [Subtitle]: 這要繞很大一圈ㄟ. (12) [Subtitle]: 是沒錯 但有那麼趕時間嗎 跟你的性命安全比起來 到底哪個比較重要 我們開車畢竟 鐵包肉 偶爾擦撞 大不了財產損失而已. (13) [Subtitle]: 但路上這麼多機車 都是肉包鐵. (14) [Subtitle]: 根據道安官網上面的 統計資料顯示 如果汽機車發生事故 機車的死傷比例 是更高的 注意交通安全 不只是保護自己 也是在保護別人呀. (15) [Subtitle]: 好像也是啦. (16) [Subtitle]: 道路安全 其實也是有在慢慢改善 像是我們去年 去新竹市的時候發現 那些車流量比較大的地方 它的雙黃線 或是道路的缺口 通通都被封起來了 交通事故 直接減少. (17) [Subtitle]: 是有在改善的哦. (18) [Subtitle]: 當然啦 除了道路安全本身 在持續改善之外 駕駛人自己注意交通安全 才是最重要. (19) [Slogan]: 廣告. [Logo]: 新竹市政府 Hsinchu City Government.

An upbeat acoustic pop BGM with bright guitar strumming and a steady percussion beat begins. (3) A soft 'pop' sound effect occurs as the female voice reacts with a playful, slightly aggressive tone. (4) The male voice delivers a detailed explanation of road safety. His speech rate is brisk but clear. The BGM remains at a consistent low-volume bed. (5) Subtle digital UI clicks accompany the appearance of animation on screen. The male speaker's tone shifts to a more authoritative narrative style while discussing statistics. (6) The male voice concludes with a warm, summarizing statement. The BGM undergoes a gentle fade-out over the final logo sequence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem Explanation -> Statistical Evidence -> Local Improvement Showcase -> Final Advice.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate drivers about the dangers of left turns, particularly emphasizing visual blind spots and the vulnerability of motorcyclists. It promotes road safety awareness and highlights the Hsinchu City Government's efforts in improving traffic safety through infrastructure changes.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video concludes with an official government logo and includes the label '廣告' (Advertisement), while the content focuses on city-specific road improvements.
